tooltips.pluginDbTitle: Il plugin Auto Tournament non riesce a raggiungere il proprio database.
tooltips.cs2UpdateBody: Auto Tournament ha verificato che la build di questo server è indietro rispetto a Steam. È escluso dalle nuove assegnazioni (e dall’avvio del torneo) finché non viene aggiornato.

developer.description: Solo per sviluppo locale; non abilitare in produzione.
developer.simulateToggleLabel: Simula i match (usa match demo con bot invece di giocatori reali)
developer.simulateNote: Quando abilitato, le configurazioni generate includono "simulation": true per match demo automatizzati.
developer.timescaleDescription: Controlla quanto velocemente girano i match simulati. Valori più alti accelerano bot e round. Si applica solo quando la simulazione è abilitata.
developer.timescaleWarning: Velocità sopra 2.0 possono essere instabili e causare comportamenti strani dei bot, ma vanno bene per test rapidi.

debugChat.label: Abilita messaggi chat di debug di MatchZy Enhanced
debugChat.description: Quando abilitato, MatchZy Enhanced stamperà messaggi di debug aggiuntivi (connessioni/disconnessioni, tracce eventi, ecc.) nella chat. Usalo solo per sviluppo e test.

reset.title: Reimpostare le impostazioni?
reset.description: Reimposta tutte le impostazioni di questa pagina ai valori predefiniti. I tornei e server esistenti non vengono modificati, ma nuovi match e lookup useranno i valori predefiniti. Continuare?

vetoTurn.label: Secondi per passo di veto
vetoTurn.helper: Se una squadra finisce il tempo, la piattaforma banna o sceglie una mappa a caso. 0 = nessun limite.

highlights.title: Highlight videos

watermark.label: Auto Tournament logo on highlight videos
watermark.description: Shown faintly in the lower right. Leaving it on helps us a lot.

perPlayer.label: Clips per player per map
perPlayer.helper: 1 to 6. Each takes the recorder about five minutes, so fewer clips are ready sooner.

quality.helper: Smaller and fewer frames record faster: 720p at 30 fps takes about half as long as 1440p at 120 fps. Clips already made keep their size.

music.label: Music under reels
music.byo: Bring your own music: add tracks you have the rights to use. Auto Tournament ships none. The player plays a different one beside each reel, and downloads come with or without it.
music.source: Where it is from (a link, for credit)
music.contentIdLabel: Registered with YouTube Content ID (an upload with it can get a claim)
music.rights: Only add music you have the rights to use in videos. Its loudness is evened out with the other tracks.
music.suggestions_one: {{count}} track that fits reels, on Pixabay
music.suggestions_other: {{count}} tracks that fit reels, on Pixabay
music.suggestionsHelp: Open one, download it from Pixabay under its license, and add it here. The license lets you use it in videos; it does not let anyone pass the file on.
music.link: Or a link to the audio file

overlay.label: Overlays
overlay.helper_one: {{count}} clip has a clean copy. Redraw puts the current caption card, kill feed and names on it again, then makes the reels again. No CS2 needed.
overlay.helper_other: {{count}} clips have a clean copy. Redraw puts the current caption card, kill feed and names on them again, then makes the reels again. No CS2 needed.
overlay.keepCleanHelper: Each clip is also stored as recorded, without the card or kill feed. Reels are then made from the clean clips with an overlay of their own, and overlays can be redrawn. Off uses about half the storage.

highlights.moved: Highlight settings, the recorders and how to add one are on their own page now:

add.hint: One command on a Linux PC with Steam and CS2. It shows up here when it first asks for work.
add.revoked: Revoked. A recorder with that key gets no more work.
add.title: Add a recorder
add.needs: Run this on a Linux PC with Docker, Steam (signed in) and CS2 installed, from its desktop session. The recorder uses its GPU and finds CS2 in its Steam libraries.
add.name: Name for this PC
add.once: This key is shown once. Copy the command now; to add another PC, make a new one.
add.after: Paste it in a terminal on the PC. It starts now and again whenever Docker does.
add.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the command and copy it
add.pcNeeds: A Linux PC with Docker, Steam (signed in) and CS2 installed. Paste this in a terminal in its desktop session. The recorder uses its GPU and finds CS2 in its Steam libraries. Don't game or run other GPU work on it while it records: the clips would stutter.
add.serverNeeds: An Ubuntu 24.04 server with an NVIDIA GPU, no desktop needed. The first line (once, with sudo) installs the NVIDIA driver and Docker and turns sleep off; reboot if it says so. The second starts Steam and CS2 in a container and the recorder in it.
add.pcAfter: It starts now and again whenever Docker does.
add.serverAfter: Then, once: open the web UI it prints (port 8483), sign Steam in, set it to offline mode and install CS2. The recorder starts taking work when CS2 is there. Run the second line again to update it.
